caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of a central, sculpted wooden column with a dark reddish-brown color, which stands on a base with four curved legs extending outward. The base and central column have visible wood grain patterns, indicating a wooden material. Attached to the upper section of the central column are four thin, looping metallic rods, each supporting a round, flat metallic plate with a concentric ring design. These plates are colored in shades of gold and brass. The rods are arranged symmetrically so that the plates are positioned at different heights around the column. On the flat top of the column, there is a cylindrical metallic structure. The background is a plain off-white or beige color with no additional objects or scenery. In the bottom right corner, the name "Richard Taylor" appears in red text.
title: Candelabra
